mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fdn_outbox (id, topic, event_type, aggregate, payload) VALUES (#{id}, #{topic}, #{eventType}, #{aggregate}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb))
mapper.select: SELECT id, topic, event_type, aggregate, payload, status, retry_count, create_at, sent_at FROM fdn_outbox WHERE status = 'NEW' ORDER BY create_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE fdn_outbox SET status = CASE WHEN #{dead} THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'NEW' END, retry_count = retry_count + 1, sent_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
